messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — HelixPay dedicated pool ded-helixpay-pool-3 experiencing sustained queue growth and latency spikes for tenant helixpay. Paging oncall for immediate triage.

sara-nguyen: Ack, I'm on it. pulling scheduler metrics and tenant queue sizes now. who has the current qlen?

li-zhou: grabbing metrics — tenant queue depth ~1200 requests, avg wait ~1.8s but tail spikes to 7-10s for very long-sequence jobs. per-tenant concurrency set to 64. max_batch_tokens (global) currently 2048.

li-zhou: suspicion: long sequence requests are saturating batch token budget causing head-of-line blocking. autoscaler hasn't responded because of cooldown window + slow queue drain.

carla-m: HelixPay support reporting 504s on some interactive payment flows. I opened a support loop and flagged SRE.

sara-nguyen: proposed targeted mitigation: apply a tenant-level override (do not touch global) — reduce max_batch_tokens to 512 for helixpay and enable queue_shaper with a lower queue_weight to smooth bursts. This should reduce head-of-line blocking.

li-zhou: command I'm prepping to run (targeted tenant override):
```
redwoodctl tenants update helixpay \\  --set scheduler.max_batch_tokens=512 \\  --set scheduler.tenant_max_concurrency=32 \\  --set scheduler.queue_shaper.enabled=true \\  --set scheduler.queue_shaper.queue_weight=0.5
```

sara-nguyen: applying now. james, can you watch autoscaler and bump pool if needed? I want to avoid global changes while we validate.

james-park: on it — increasing desired count for ded-helixpay-pool-3 from 6 -> 9 GPUs, pausing scale-down. watching for errors.

ops-rotations: noted. I'll also pin this incident to rotations and notify account team.

li-zhou: change applied: scheduler.max_batch_tokens override for helixpay set 2048 -> 512. Immediate signals: p95 queue latency dropped from ~9.4s -> ~2.1s, queue depth down from ~1200 -> ~300 in the last 30s.

carla-m: great. drafting a short external note for HelixPay: "We've applied tenant-level queue shaping and reduced batch token budget to mitigate latency. Monitoring now; expect recovery in 15-30m." Want me to send?

sara-nguyen: please send. include that we may revert if we see regressions.

james-park: autoscaler bumped to 9 GPUs successfully. GPU utilization now ~60%. no scaling errors observed.

li-zhou: quick tradeoff note: saw a small throughput regression on short requests (~-8%), expected since batch token cap is lower. latency improvement is primary win.

ops-rotations: handoff reminder — sara is handing to james in 20m. james will own the channel/monitoring until 0200 UTC. add runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-queue-shaper

james-park: confirmed take. will maintain monitoring and escalate to eng-sre if anything degrades.

sara-nguyen: I'll update the incident ticket with the config diff and rationale: long sequences >= 2048 tokens were monopolizing batch formation causing head-of-line blocking. Tenant override reduces max_batch_tokens to 512 and enables queue shaping. Follow-ups: collect token-length histogram for helixpay, propose permanent tenant profile, consider per-model small-batch pathways.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident created PD-INC-2026-54321 and assigned to james-park.

li-zhou: scheduler snapshot after change:
```
tenant: helixpay
queue_depth: 312
p50_latency_ms: 210
p95_latency_ms: 2120
active_batches: 18
avg_batch_tokens: 420
max_batch_tokens_override: 512
```

sara-nguyen: closing loop on immediate mitigation. will keep monitoring for 1hr then propose a permanent config in tenant profile. thanks team :thumbsup:

james-park: taking over monitoring and will post a final handoff when I sign out.
